title: Corpus of Pyu inscriptions
description:
This zip file contains the XML of the Corpus of Pyu Inscriptions. The transliterations are by Arlo Griffiths, Marc Miyake, and Julian K. Wheatley. The corpus is constantly being updated at http://hisoma-huma-num.fr/exist/apps/pyu/index2.html .

Each XML corresponds to a Pyu inscription.

In the transliterations, C indicates an unknown consonant, and V indicates an unknown vowel.
